naicsTitle: Machine Shops; Turned Product; and Screw, Nut, and Bolt Manufacturing
title: Most-cited OSHA standards: machine shops, turned product and fastener makers (NAICS 3327)
seoTitle: Machine shop safety: top OSHA citations (NAICS 3327)
description: Top OSHA citations in NAICS 3327 (machine shops, turned product, fasteners), FY2022–FY2026: lockout/tagout, machine guarding, hazard communication.
opening: In machine shops, turned product and screw, nut and bolt manufacturing (NAICS 3327), OSHA cited 1910.147, the control of hazardous energy (lockout/tagout), most often from FY2022–FY2026: 815 of 5,253 citations, ahead of 1910.212 (general requirements for all machines) and 1910.1200 (hazard communication).
patternsSummary: Machinery hazards lead the NAICS 3327 list: besides 1910.147 lockout/tagout (815 citations), three Subpart O machine guarding standards rank high, namely 1910.212 general requirements for all machines (653), 1910.215 abrasive wheel machinery (280) and 1910.219 mechanical power-transmission apparatus (135). Chemical and airborne hazards come next, with 1910.1200 hazard communication cited 639 times and 1910.134 respiratory protection 375 times. 1910.178 powered industrial trucks (354) and the Subpart S electrical standards 1910.303 (226) and 1910.305 (203) follow close behind.
penaltiesSummary: The median penalty per penalised citation in NAICS 3327 was $3,405 over FY2022–FY2026, and the middle half of penalties fell between $1,200 and $6,222. Of all citations, 68% were classed as serious, 31% other-than-serious, 1% repeat and 0% willful.

Covers respiratory protection, within Subpart I on personal protective equipment.
Covers powered industrial trucks, part of Subpart N on materials handling and storage.

Covers wiring methods, components and equipment for general use, also in Subpart S.
